text:
Ava (PeopleOps): FYI I'm posting a short set of goal-handoff templates — manager -> IC and peer-facing one-pagers. Wanted to get feedback before we attach to the self-review kit.

Sam (Eng Manager): love that. can you do a tiny variant for ICs who work across two teams?

Ava (PeopleOps): yes — I made a 'dual-team' header + ownership bullets. keeping everything 3 bullets max for impact clarity.

Priya (Product): could we include a quick example of success criteria tied to metrics? product teams always ask for measurable examples.

Ava (PeopleOps): good call. included an example under each goal: 

```
Goal: Reduce inference tail latency
Owner: Diego
Success criteria: p95 latency <= 120ms on release traffic for 3 consecutive days; end-to-end e2e test pass rate >= 99%
Signals: per-route latency dashboard, cost per 1M tokens
Risks/Dependencies: infra autoscaler rollout, model quantization experiment
```

Diego (IC): that example is perfect. can we add a one-sentence 'why this matters' line? helps motivate priorities during 1:1s.

Ava (PeopleOps): added a short "why" field to each template. also added a mini manager rubric for acceptance: 

```
Manager acceptance quick-check (3 items)
- Clear outcome and metric (yes/no)
- Owner understands dependencies (yes/no)
- Stretch/commit split noted (yes/no)
```

Sam (Eng Manager): sweet. any suggestions for peer feedback prompts to pair with these? want to make peer review high-signal but low-friction.

Ava (PeopleOps): drafted 4 micro-prompts for peers: 
- "What was one tangible impact this goal created?"
- "Was the owner responsive to cross-team needs?"
- "Any missed risks we should call out?"
- "One suggestion to amplify impact next quarter"

Priya (Product): can we add an explicit 'what to stop doing' prompt? helps calibration.

Ava (PeopleOps): done — added as optional prompt. also created a 1-page printable handoff card (PDF link placeholder) and a short blurb for onboarding managers.

HR Bot: Note: Attaching a template counts as a resource update — please allow 24 hours for propagation to the self-review hub.

Diego (IC): anything I should prep before our team kickoff?

Ava (PeopleOps): if you're leading a goal, bring the 3-line goal, success metric, 1 blocker, and the 'why' sentence. that'll make the sync fast.

Sam (Eng Manager): can you drop the final files in the #docs channel and ping managers later today? i'll do a quick pass after lunch. :thumbsup:

Ava (PeopleOps): yep — I'll upload to #docs and add to the self-review checklist. thanks all for quick feedback.
